Validates product in a regulated setting and can drive recurring software revenue.
Broader agency adoption can lead to additional seats and renewals.
Opens non-pharma market segments beyond core biopharma.
Signals regulatory workflows integrating SLP models, raising stickiness.
Continues trend towards animal-free methods where modeling demand is rising.

This is a mid-cycle validation of SLP’s push beyond pharma into regulated non-pharma markets. A larger catalyst would be disclosures of contract value, multi-year seats, or additional FDA divisions adopting the platform.
